title: Left-tail expansions for Schröder branching processes with explicit convergence rates
summary: In previous work, the density of the martingale limit in Schröder branching processes was expressed as a convergent double power-law series with oscillatory terms. The proof relied on two assumptions, one of which imposed a geometric restriction on the critical angle of the Julia set of the offspring generating function near $1$. In this paper, we show that both assumptions can be removed. We derive explicit bounds on the expansion coefficients, which imply locally uniform convergence of the double series.
